Thank you for alerting us. The embedded material was inadvertently included, is confidential, and was not intended as a communication or negotiating position. Please do not use, rely on or further circulate it. Please delete the affected copy and any extracts, instruct any recipients to do the same, and confirm completion. If retention is legally required, please segregate the material and restrict access pending agreement on handling. We reserve all applicable rights and protections.

We are providing a replacement copy with the embedded material removed. Price remains reserved. Our revised language requires specifically identified financial statements and accounting standards, limits disclosure qualifications to specifically identified matters, and extends indemnity to covenant breaches. We have also expressly excluded fraud, title, authority and tax liabilities from the general limitations, while reserving separately negotiated treatment for title, authority and tax. Please confirm the financial statement particulars and proposed liability framework so these items can be completed before signing. All proposals remain subject to client approval.

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the Company's financial statements listed in Schedule 3, which shall identify each statement by type, date, period covered and audited or unaudited status and attach a copy, fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the Company for the periods covered, in accordance with [identify applicable accounting standards and jurisdiction before signing], consistently applied, subject, for unaudited statements only, to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of footnotes. This representation is qualified only by matters fairly disclosed in the corresponding section of the disclosure schedules agreed at signing, with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of the exception. Disclosure in another section qualifies this representation only where its applicability is reasonably apparent on the face of that disclosure. General references to the data room or other information supplied to the Buyer do not qualify this representation.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations expressly agreed in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses actually incurred as a direct result of a breach of the Seller's express representations, warranties or covenants. A matter fairly disclosed in accordance with Clause 3 shall qualify only the representation or warranty to which it applies and shall not excuse a breach of covenant. Recovery shall be reduced only to the extent the same loss was specifically provided for in the identified financial statements and that provision actually reduced the Purchase Price. Before signing, the parties shall expressly agree an aggregate liability cap, claim threshold, survival periods and claims procedure. The general cap, claim threshold and survival limitations shall not apply to fraud, breaches of the Seller's express representations concerning title to the Shares or authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, or liabilities under the separately agreed tax indemnity. Title, authority and tax claims shall instead be subject only to any separate limits and time periods expressly agreed for those categories before signing. The scope of the tax indemnity, including allocation of pre-Closing taxes and control of tax claims, shall be agreed before signing. There shall be no double recovery, and recoveries shall be reduced by insurance proceeds actually received for the same loss, net of reasonable recovery costs. Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud.
